name: Sword and Pistol Sharpness (Combat, Style)
body:
Your finesse when wielding a firearm and a melee weapon together increases.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 14, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Snap Shot, Sword and Pistol, Two–Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): When you use the Two–Weapon Fighting feat while wielding a one-handed melee weapon and a crossbow or firearm, the penalty on attack rolls both for your primary hand and your off hand lessens by 2. This stacks with the penalty reduction granted by Two–Weapon Fighting.
